data.one_liner: A foreground service plugin for Flutter supporting Android.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter applications to run a foreground service on Android with customizable intervals and callbacks. Supports updating notification title and contents.
use_when: You need to run long-running tasks in a foreground service on Android
You need periodic callback execution within a foreground service
avoid_when: You need to change the notification level
data.setup_notes: Requires adding the FOREGROUND_SERVICE permission, declaring the service in AndroidManifest.xml, setting the min SDK, and providing notification icons.
